After confirming with my copy of ''Crossroads of Twilight'' and checking my copy of ''The Shadow Rising'', it is clear that this page is entirely incorrect. The bracelet that Aviendha wears in Chapter 20 of COT is the same bracelet she is referred to as wearing since receiving it from Rand in the first few pages of TSR chapter 50. There is nothing in the referenced chapter of COT to indicate that this bracelet is a ter'angreal, I remember nothing indicating such in the other books, and I have found no other reference to it being one on any other part of the Internet. I will completely rewrite this page, but I believe it is a good candidate for deletion as the bracelet is not an object of the Power.
